source: Framework clauses and mapping targets per the repo's R3 control-map dossier. Regulatory citations verified verbatim against canonical EUR-Lex in R3. Legal text is cited, never restated here.
honesty_note: These framework clauses are authorship-agnostic: none imposes an AI-specific obligation, and auditors today accept conventional SDLC evidence (protected branches, PR approvals, CI logs) for AI-authored changes identically to human-authored ones. AI-specific attestation is future-proofing, not a present legal necessity (repo dossier R3). This control map is a mapping, not an audit opinion, a certification, or legal advice.

clause_caveats.ISO/IEC 27001:2022: ISO control text is copyrighted/paywalled; control intent is corroborated from auditor guidance, not quoted from the standard (R3 §3).
clause_caveats.SOC 2: AICPA Trust Services Criteria is a private framework, not law (R3 §4).
clause_caveats.US SSDF (NIST SP 800-218): Evidenced via the CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Common Form (self-attestation; process-based; silent on AI authorship) (R3 §8).
clause_caveats.DORA (EU) 2024/1774: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1774; in force 2025-01-17. Distinct from base Reg. (EU) 2022/2554 Art. 17 (incident management) — the RTS article is the operative one (R3 §2).

controls.observed_control: Adversarial / peer review gate before deliverable commits
controls.detected_by: Per commit: a structured 'Governor-Review: PASS' trailer bound to a review artifact by content hash ('Governor-Review-Ref: sha256:<hex>'), recorded by 'kerbtap review record' and re-checkable with 'kerbtap review verify'. A free-text review note alone is not counted.

clauses.intent: Changes are authorized, designed, developed, tested, approved, and implemented under a controlled process.
Documented, approved, tested, and segregated ICT changes; verification of security requirements.
Review and/or analyze human-readable code to identify vulnerabilities and verify compliance with requirements.

controls.observed_control: Change management via feature-branch + pull request (direct-to-main tracked as a documented exception)
controls.detected_by: Changes land through merge-commit or squash-merge pull requests rather than being committed straight to the default branch.

clauses.intent: Documented, approved, and controlled ICT changes.

controls.observed_control: Segregation of duties between change author and change approver
controls.detected_by: Per change: the PR's recorded merge actor differs from its recorded author (pull_request.merged_by vs author_login in the manifest). A review trailer is not identity-bound, so it does not attest segregation of duties. Counted only where that evidence was actually collected.

clauses.intent: Segregation between change-approving and change-requesting functions.

controls.observed_control: Deny-by-default merge gate (GitHub branch protection / rulesets on the default branch)
controls.detected_by: GitHub branch metadata plus ruleset/classic-protection configuration read via the GitHub API at collection time. This is the CURRENT configuration — a repo-level control record, not per-change evidence that historical changes were gated (protection history is not readable).

clauses.intent: Changes are authorized and approved under a controlled process.
Change management enforced by a technical control rather than convention alone.
Documented, approved, and controlled ICT changes.
Code review before integration, where the gate requires an approving review.

controls.detected_by: Presence of a CODEOWNERS file at a standard location (.github/CODEOWNERS, CODEOWNERS, or docs/CODEOWNERS). Advisory routing unless branch protection/rulesets require code-owner review (see the merge-gate record); file contents are deliberately not quoted into the pack.

clauses.intent: Designated reviewers for human-readable code, routed by ownership.

controls.observed_control: Enforcing pre-commit review hook (blocks guarded commits until the bypass prefix is typed; does not check for a recorded review)
controls.detected_by: Presence of .claude/hooks/precommit_review_guard.py — a deny-mode gate that blocks a commit of a guarded file until the operator types the bypass prefix. It does not check for a recorded review.

clauses.intent: Change management enforced by a technical control rather than convention alone.

controls.detected_by: Presence of docs/decision-log.md — a dated decision log versioned in git. Append-only is a documented convention, not an enforced technical control; the underlying versioned record is git history.

clauses.intent: Logging of ICT-change-management events for the audit trail.
